title: M11-OPS-02b4 Ling Fin bounded route and scientific replacement preregistration
classification: local design choice, not evidence of Google private behavior
status: frozen before any Ling Fin inference; no interface or scientific trial launched

candidate.model_configuration: existing production per-call temperature, token and reasoning options, unchanged for every scientific trial; interface probe uses the fixed synthetic options in probe_capabilities.py

baseline.comparison: candidate trial i against retained M1 trial i on byte-identical public inputs and unchanged assessor/evaluator rubric; historical matched-input pairs, not concurrent randomization

stages.criteria: all four exact labels partial/supports/insufficient/contradicts; self-contained verbatim quotes where required; model-primary verdicts, no fallback, complete served-model/usage evidence

at least 27/30 correct (at most one additional error versus M1 28/30), contradiction recall at least .80, no new false contradiction, historical and controlled-primary and single/batch scope controls pass, no fallback
at least 13/16 correct, zero useless spans called useful, at least 6/7 useful and 2/3 partial correct, no fallback
at least 7/8 correct top choices, mean Kendall tau-b at least .68, no top ties or fallback

acceptance_rationale: M1 Nex Pro: batch 4/4; citation 28/30 and .80 contradiction recall; usefulness 13/16 with zero false useful; ranking 8/8 and lowest tau-b .7781. Candidate may lose at most one citation or top-choice item and .0981 tau-b, with no contradiction-recall or usefulness loss. These are small public screens, not expert validation.

execution.credential: only OPENROUTER_API_KEY extracted in launcher memory; no dotenv or secret in arguments/artifacts
execution.pre_batch_admission: fresh official catalog, exact endpoint and ZDR inventory; exact zero prompt/completion and binding zero request cap; stop on unknown price/status
execution.stop: Stop on admission/privacy/budget error, terminal transport failure, or an unrecovered rate-limit response; retain every physical attempt and its error. An internally recovered transport or 429 retry within the hard physical-call ceiling is allowed by remaining-panel-criteria.md and is not a scientific error. Never selectively rerun a bad quality trial; after a terminal 429 pause this stage and work elsewhere until reset.
execution.drift: commit amendment before changed input/code/config/rubric; rerun both sides if matching is lost
execution.usage: Record every physical attempt and response/error. Require served-model and prompt/completion usage for every successful completion; retain failed attempts, zero-price request caps, fallback evidence and response cost if present. A static zero estimate is not a billing receipt.
execution.release: no default/deploy before the interface and all scientific stages pass and M11-OPS-02c verifies a public workflow
execution.trial_launch: Set QUALIFICATION_TRIAL=1..3, QUALIFICATION_REVISION to the committed current HEAD, MODEL_NAME to the exact candidate, QUALIFICATION_OUTPUT to a new exclusive-create artifact, and QUALIFICATION_PANEL for usefulness/ranking. Launch a fresh child with only PATH/HOME/LANG/TMPDIR, PYTHONPATH to this worktree engine/src:app:root, and OPENROUTER_API_KEY extracted in memory from the existing Railway API variable list. Never print or persist the key.
execution.complete_evidence: For each completed trial verify frozen input/rubric hashes, exact provider controls on every physical attempt, served model and prompt/completion usage on successful responses, zero-cost receipts where reported, no deterministic fallback, and declared per-item metrics before proceeding.

limits: retained M1 pairs are historical, not contemporaneous provider randomization
same model ID need not imply stable future quality
passing synthetic panels does not prove expert or wet-lab scientific validity
Ling Fin shares the Ling Sante model family; a distinct checkpoint is not an independent architecture or proof of better scientific quality.

baseline_match_audit.interpretation: Nex Pro routing is unchanged by the exact-route additions; timeout classification and two other candidate-specific schema overrides changed since M1. The candidate model and route policy are the intended intervention. Panel identity digests therefore differ and panel_comparison cannot certify this cross-model comparison; compare fixed public inputs and preregistered metrics directly.

primary_metric.name: independently qualified exact-zero ZDR standby route count
primary_metric.interpretation: operational resilience after the advertised Nex Pro retirement date; not a claim of improved scientific accuracy or authority to switch production while Nex Pro remains eligible

decision_rule.qualify: Interface panel passes, then all three completed trials pass every staged scientific gate with complete served-model/usage evidence on successful responses and zero-cost/privacy controls on all attempts; source/input/config hashes fixed.
decision_rule.inconclusive: Interface error, mixed scientific series, missing usage, unrecovered rate limit, terminal provider error, or changed setting leaves the candidate open for diagnosis, never silently promoted; an internally recovered retry is judged by the completed trial and full telemetry.
decision_rule.reject: repeatable completed structural or scientific failure under the frozen configuration, with raw failures preserved and no post-hoc threshold change
decision_rule.production: qualification only selects a standby candidate; M11-OPS-02c separately controls switch and release

candidate_source_manifest.scope: all current app/app, engine/src/co_scientist, evaluations Python modules plus frozen scope inputs; consumed by citation runner imported_sources guard

environment.QUALIFICATION_REVISION: current committed HEAD at launch; runner verifies against git HEAD, while this protocol pins actual source/input hashes
environment.QUALIFICATION_PREREG_SHA256: fixed 64-character digest recorded in PLAN M11-OPS-02b4b after protocol commit; never recompute from this file at launch

interface_stage.fresh_admission: Immediately before launch, verify official catalog model is exact-zero, Novita exact endpoint is available with zero prompt/completion prices and ZDR inventory contains that endpoint; unknown request price is permitted only with the binding max_price.request=0 cap; stop if any fact is unverified.
interface_stage.pass: All six cases pass within their per-case physical caps and cumulative seven-call cap, with no fallback and exact Novita-only, ZDR, data-denial and zero prompt/completion/request caps on every physical request. Each non-streaming successful response must have complete observed-model and prompt/completion usage evidence; streaming must have accepted SDK model fields and a usage chunk with prompt/completion tokens. A streaming SDK model field is not an independent provider receipt. The route may include only the existing preferred_min_throughput=25 extra beyond the pinned provider controls; order is forbidden.
interface_stage.stop: The single bounded process stops on the first failed result, transport error, 429, missing model/usage evidence, routing/cap violation or seven-call ceiling. Unknown case names, wrong order, existing output, or source drift fail before transport. Do not repeat a failed case to manufacture a pass; a partial result remains open for diagnosis.
interface_stage.scientific_release_gate: Only after this panel passes may the four scientific stages below run; this panel alone cannot select a production route.
interface_stage.launch: Launch one credential-isolated process with all six cases in the fixed order. The bounded runner validates the pinned preregistration/model/source hashes and reserves the absent output before transport. Its existing process-wide seven-call counter covers the whole panel; after each case it validates result, route and usage evidence and stops before the next case on a failure.
